title: Interior adhered masonry veneers.
officialText:
Interior adhered masonry veneers shall have a maximum weight of 20 psf (0.958
kg/m2) and shall be installed in accordance with Section 1405.10. Where the interior adhered masonry veneer is supported by
wood construction, the supporting members shall be designed to limit deflection to 1/600 of the span of the supporting members.
